content: गभीर {%m.%} [गच्छति जलमत्र, गभ् ईरन् भान्तादेशश्च <ls>Uṇ. 4. 35</ls>] .²1 Deep (in all senses); उत्तालास्त इमे गभीरपयसः पुण्याः सरित्संगमाः <ls>U. 2. 30</ls>; <ls>Bv. 2. 105</ls>. .²2 Deep-sounding (as a drum). .²3 Thick, dense, impervious (as a forest); <ls>Ki. 14. 39</ls>. .²4 Profound, sagacious. .²5 Grave, serious, solemn, earnest. .²6 Secret, mysterious. .²7 Inscrutable, difficult to be perceived or understood; गभीरमर्थं कतिचित्प्रकाशताम् (नयन्ति) <ls>Ki. 14. 4</ls>.
